mapper.select: SELECT symbol_id AS "symbolId" , kind AS "kind" , fqn AS "fqn" , simple_name AS "simpleName" , visibility AS "visibility" , is_abstract AS "isAbstract" , layer AS "layer" , layer_confidence AS "layerConfidence" , properties_json->>'synthetic' AS "synthetic" , line_start AS "lineStart" , line_end AS "lineEnd" FROM analysis_symbol WHERE file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY line_start, fqn

SELECT owner_symbol_id AS "ownerSymbolId" , name AS "name" , type AS "type" , is_static AS "isStatic" , is_synthetic AS "isSynthetic" FROM analysis_field WHERE file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY line_start, name

SELECT method_id AS "methodId" , owner_symbol_id AS "ownerSymbolId" , name AS "name" , signature AS "signature" , return_type AS "returnType" , param_count AS "paramCount" , visibility AS "visibility" , is_static AS "isStatic" , is_abstract AS "isAbstract" , is_constructor AS "isConstructor" , is_synthetic AS "isSynthetic" , synthetic_origin AS "syntheticOrigin" , proxy_related AS "proxyRelated" , line_start AS "lineStart" , line_end AS "lineEnd" FROM analysis_method WHERE file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY line_start, signature

SELECT target_kind AS "targetKind" , target_id AS "targetId" , annotation_name AS "name" , attributes_json::text AS "attributes" FROM analysis_annotation WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND target_kind IN ('TYPE', 'METHOD') ORDER BY annotation_id

SELECT r.from_id AS "fromId" , r.relation_type AS "relationType" , COALESCE(s.fqn, r.to_external) AS "target" FROM analysis_relation r LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = r.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = r.to_id WHERE r.file_id = #{fileId} AND r.relation_type IN ('EXTENDS', 'IMPLEMENTS', 'INJECTS') ORDER BY r.relation_id

SELECT DISTINCT r.from_id AS "fromId" , r.relation_type AS "relationType" , r.confidence AS "confidence" , (r.to_id IS NOT NULL) AS "inProject" , COALESCE(ts.fqn || '#' || tm.signature, r.to_external) AS "target" FROM analysis_relation r LEFT JOIN analysis_method tm ON tm.revision_id = r.revision_id AND tm.method_id = r.to_id LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol ts ON ts.revision_id = tm.revision_id AND ts.symbol_id = tm.owner_symbol_id WHERE r.file_id = #{fileId} AND r.relation_type IN ('CALLS', 'CALLS_POSSIBLE_IMPLEMENTATION')

SELECT t.to_id AS "toId", t.caller AS "caller", t.total AS "total" FROM ( SELECT x.to_id, x.caller , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY x.to_id ORDER BY x.caller) AS rn , COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY x.to_id) AS total FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT r.to_id , COALESCE(cs.fqn || '#' || cm.signature, fs.fqn || '#' || cf.name, ts.fqn) AS caller FROM analysis_method m JOIN analysis_relation r ON r.revision_id = m.revision_id AND r.to_id = m.method_id AND r.relation_type IN ('CALLS', 'CALLS_POSSIBLE_IMPLEMENTATION') LEFT JOIN analysis_method cm ON r.from_kind = 'METHOD' AND cm.revision_id = r.revision_id AND cm.method_id = r.from_id LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol cs ON cs.revision_id = cm.revision_id AND cs.symbol_id = cm.owner_symbol_id LEFT JOIN analysis_field cf ON r.from_kind = 'FIELD' AND cf.revision_id = r.revision_id AND cf.field_id = r.from_id LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol fs ON fs.revision_id = cf.revision_id AND fs.symbol_id = cf.owner_symbol_id LEFT JOIN analysis_symbol ts ON r.from_kind = 'TYPE' AND ts.revision_id = r.revision_id AND ts.symbol_id = r.from_id WHERE m.file_id = #{fileId} AND r.from_id <> r.to_id ) x WHERE x.caller IS NOT NULL ) t WHERE t.rn <= #{limit} ORDER BY t.to_id, t.rn

SELECT e.method_id AS "methodId" , e.endpoint_type AS "endpointType" , e.http_method AS "httpMethod" , e.path AS "path" FROM analysis_endpoint e JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = e.revision_id AND m.method_id = e.method_id WHERE e.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY e.endpoint_type, e.path
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_document (document_id, source_type, project_id, revision_id, doc_type, ref_kind, ref_id, title, source_path, metadata_json, content_hash) VALUES (#{documentId}, 'CODE', #{projectId}, #{revisionId}, #{docType}, #{refKind}, #{refId}, #{title}, #{sourcePath} , CAST(#{metadataJson} AS jsonb), #{contentHash})

INSERT INTO rag_embedding (content_hash, model, dimensions, status) SELECT DISTINCT c.content_hash, #{model}, #{dimensions}, 'PENDING' FROM rag_chunk c WHERE c.file_id = #{fileId} ON CONFLICT (content_hash, model) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT e.content_hash AS "contentHash" , (SELECT c.content FROM rag_chunk c WHERE c.content_hash = e.content_hash LIMIT 1) AS "content" FROM rag_embedding e WHERE e.status = 'PENDING' AND e.model = #{model} ORDER BY e.created_at, e.content_hash LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE rag_embedding SET embedding = CAST(#{vector} AS vector) , status = 'DONE' , last_error = NULL , embedded_at = now() WHERE content_hash = #{contentHash} AND model = #{model}
mapper.select: SELECT d.doc_type AS "docType" , COUNT(DISTINCT d.doc_seq) AS "documents" , COUNT(c.chunk_id) AS "chunks" , COALESCE(SUM(c.char_count), 0) AS "chars" FROM rag_document d LEFT JOIN rag_chunk c ON c.doc_seq = d.doc_seq WHERE d.revision_id = #{revisionId} GROUP BY d.doc_type ORDER BY d.doc_type
SELECT revision_id FROM analysis_revision WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND status = 'READY' ORDER BY revision_id DESC LIMIT 1
